These offline schema replays contain sanitized employers, identifiers and URLs.
They do not establish verified ATS identifiers, live vacancies, or automation
permission for any employer. Greenhouse and Lever follow the existing recorded
project fixtures; Workday, SmartRecruiters, Ashby and JSON-LD preserve public
response field shapes with small pages for deterministic pagination coverage.
The research worker's separately owned `sg_research` directory contains dated
live endpoint and access-policy evidence; it is not used as permission here.
